QuestInfo.name: Perion Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Ayan of Perion is beginning winter preparations for the tribesmen. She looks like she could use some help. Go find Ayan in Perion and give her some help.
QuestInfo.1: Ayan of Perion says that the tribesmen need plenty of firewood to prepare for winter. The campfire burned out while she was gathering firewood, so she asks you to bring her 20 pieces of Burning Firewood.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Ayan restore her campfire. Hopefully the burning campfire will keep Ayan warm through the winter.

0.0: It sure is getting colder, huh? The tribesmen of Perion rely heavily on the campfire during winter. So we try to gather as much firewood as possible and do our best to keep the fire burning. But I accidentally put out the fire. If Blackbull finds out, I'll be in trouble. Would you please help me?
